name: Knee Raise (Captain's Chair)
instructions: Support yourself on the padded arm rests with your back against the pad.
Let your legs hang straight down.
Raise your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis up.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A knee raise in a captain's chair apparatus that trains the lower abs and hip flexors.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

safetyNotes: Keep your back against the pad; stop if your shoulders or elbows hurt.
